reflect.proud_of: What did you handle today that deserves a small, dignified nod?
reflect.learned: What did you figure out today that future you will want on record?
reflect.surprised: What caught you off guard today? Good or bad, log it.
reflect.hardest_moment: What was the roughest stretch today, and how did you get through it?
reflect.energy: What kept your batteries charged today, and what ran them down?
reflect.would_redo: Hindsight is free. What would you change if today got a second run?
reflect.avoided: What are you avoiding? The dark corner of the to-do list counts.
reflect.turning_point: When did today's plan fall apart, or come together? Mark the moment.
reflect.habit_win: Which survival task did you secure today, and how did it feel?
reflect.time_well_spent: Where did you spend your time wisely today? Hours are limited stock.
reflect.stuck_on: What's got you pinned down at the moment?
reflect.someone_helped: Who watched your back today, or whose back did you watch?
reflect.change_mind: What were you sure of once that you've since changed your mind about?
reflect.old_self: Radio a message back a year. What should past you know?
gratitude.small_win: What's one thing worth surviving for today?
gratitude.person: Who is in your camp that you're glad to have? Say why.
gratitude.comfort: What small comfort made today more bearable? A warm drink counts.
gratitude.unexpected: Something went right when it had no business to. What was it?
gratitude.body: Your body kept going today. What did it do well?
gratitude.place: Where have you felt safest lately?
gratitude.skill: Which skill are you glad you have? Think of when it came in handy.
gratitude.taste: What did you eat or drink today that beat standard rations?
gratitude.kindness: Someone did something decent today. What was it?
gratitude.challenge: Which grim little challenge is teaching you something useful?
gratitude.morning: What made this morning bearable? Sunrise, coffee, silence?
gratitude.tech: Which gadget or tool earned its place in the pack today?
gratitude.nature: What did the outside world show you today? A clear sky, weeds through the pavement?
gratitude.memory: What good memory from before surfaced today?
gratitude.tomorrow: What's worth looking forward to tomorrow? Low bar, no pressure.
goals.this_week: What would make this a week you're glad you survived?
goals.one_thing: If you could only secure one thing next, what is it?
goals.first_step: Big jobs start with small ones. What's step one?
goals.obstacle: What's blocking the road, and how do you get round it?
goals.habit_next: Which survival task should join the daily routine next?
goals.stop_doing: What bad habit is doing nothing for your odds? Time to drop it.
goals.month_ahead: A month from now, where do you want to be standing?
goals.stretch: What's one job that unnerves you slightly but looks doable?
goals.who_help: Who's worth having on your side for this one, and will you ask?
goals.finish: What will you actually finish? Loose ends attract trouble.
goals.learn: What do you want to learn next? Assume it'll come in handy.
goals.rest_plan: When do you next get to hole up and recover, and what does that involve?
goals.big_picture: Why bother? Say what today's effort is actually building towards.
goals.tiny_win: What's one small win you can secure before tomorrow is over?
wellbeing.mood_word: Status check: one word for how you're holding up.
wellbeing.body_check: Quick inspection. How's your body doing?
wellbeing.sleep: How was the sleep, and what would make tonight's better?
wellbeing.stress: What's weighing on you? Put it on the table where you can see it.
wellbeing.recharge: What restocks you when you're running low?
wellbeing.boundaries: What line did you hold today, or where do you need to draw one?
wellbeing.breath: Stand down for a moment. One slow breath. What do you notice?
wellbeing.move: How did you move today? A stretch, a walk or a brisk dash all count.
wellbeing.screen_time: Hours staring at glowing screens: how did they leave you feeling?
wellbeing.connection: Who did you make contact with today? A short radio call counts.
wellbeing.fuel: How did you fuel up today? Be honest about the rations.
wellbeing.worry_park: Pick one worry and leave it at the door for tonight. It'll keep.
wellbeing.joy: Even now there's joy. What was a moment of it today?
wellbeing.kind_self: Go easy on the survivor in the mirror. What kind thing would you tell them?
wellbeing.pause: When did you lie low for a minute today? What did it give you?
